notes.title: Mystery Kink is LIVE on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
Hey Gamers!

We're running a [b]Kickstarter[/b] for [i]Mystery Kink[/i] NOW! The Kickstarter ends [b]October 31st, Halloween Night![/b]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/vanillabeastgame/vanillabeast-mystery-kink?ref=1b3ij5]MYSTERY KINK ON KICKSTARTER[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44834902/278af52e4bd274f946742d94d82051c5304613f5.png[/img]

We've got some great rewards including:

[list]
[*] Get [b]DRAWN IN THE GAME[/b]! by [i]Oleg Okunev[/i]. Yes, [b]YOU[/b], can be drawn in [i]Mystery Kink[/i] with Vanilla and the girls.
[*] Awesome autographed limited merch signed by the women of Mystery Kink.
[*] Comic art prints and "sexy" physical art prints.
[*] Shirts, mugs, hats, and hoodies.
[*] Physical Trading cards of Vanilla and the women of Mystery Kink (signed / unsigned).
[*] Tons more great rewards including a great deal on Ktulhu Solutions games (our partner developer).
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44834902/93e0e5e2c98488aca896c07d858a7bb62780e9e4.png[/img]

As we mentioned above, the [u]Kickstarter ends October 31st[/u] so hurry over.

**Some rewards may be available as Kickstarter's new "late pledge" reward program after Oct 31st, but supplies are limited.

Hurry over today!!! [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/vanillabeastgame/vanillabeast-mystery-kink?ref=1b3ij5]MYSTERY KINK ON KICKSTARTER[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44834902/9e669915abc67fa16ca6e10094624266f064c1b3.png[/img]
